rationale: Neither review reproduces the two literal ground-truth threads (both already resolved by the time of this diff), but Y is the one that actually engages the substance behind them: it repeatedly flags that Ref2VA was never measured/validated on this host and that the restart/OOM path is unsafe, directly echoing the human reviewer's 'have you tested ref2va mode?' concern, and it also catches a genuine self-contradicting math error in the memory-floor claim verifiable from the diff text alone. X's four findings (numactl flags, README indexing, audio_reference format, dangling PRO-5000 reference) are valid and grounded but minor, and two of them are independently corroborated by Y, while X never touches validation trustworthiness or Ref2VA readiness at all. Y is far more verbose, but the added length is substantive analysis rather than padding, so it wins on recall and actionability while precision is roughly comparable.
